items.title: Does Baker Hughes (BKR) Change The Story With Its Cyprus Subsea Contract?
items.summary: Baker Hughes (NasdaqGS:BKR) has secured a major subsea production systems contract from Eni for the Cronos deepwater gas field offshore Cyprus. The award covers subsea equipment and related technology for Eni’s large offshore Cronos gas development, expanding Baker Hughes’ offshore project portfolio. items.title: Rig count unchanged as prices climb
items.summary: The rig count in the Permian Basin was unchanged this week, the latest count Friday by Baker Hughes shows, with 272 rigs active in the region. A year ago, 251 rigs were active in the region. Nationally, the oil and gas rig count is unchanged from last week at 603 rigs. A year ago, 546 rigs were active. items.title: BKR Q3 deep dive: order momentum and integration progress offset by margin pressures
items.summary: Energy technology company Baker Hughes (NASDAQ:BKR) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 14.5% year on year to $8.03 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.70 per share was 13.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
